title: An acid trip at the Chelsea and Gil's views on acid
summary: Johnston describes a nude young man wrecking the hotel hallway. Gil says acid should be taken only by those who know themselves.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: I remember one night, you were talking about acid, it was three o'clock in the morning and I heard noises in this hotel room such as I'd never heard before. And I was interested in one interview you gave me in which you said you could identify automobiles by their sound when you were a kid.
Well I've lived in this hotel long enough now to be able to tell who is walking by. If they're the regular people and what's happening out there. But the sound I......

Yes. This morning at three o'clock I heard things that I had never heard before. And things came crushing down the steps and I thought I heard violent arguments and I went to the telephone, I said, somebody is having a terrible fight up here.
Well, I put something on and just as I got out to the end of my little corridor here of course which is at the bottom of the steps, I looked up and

there was this perfectly nude young white man coming down the steps. (LAUGHTER). And he had been pulling off all the fire extinguishers and that's was the noise I heard you see. And they were all rolling down the steps. Water was purring down everywhere. We used to have little benches outside the elevators, he was throwing all that furniture around. So that's why I couldn't identify the sound that night. But that was acid, that was a real acid trip, yes.

Well I say they can take acid, but they have to take it under certain circumstances. I have to explain to them where they could take it and where they couldn't take it. For example, in the city they couldn't take it.
Why wouldn't you just try as well as you trying to keep them off heroin, try to keep them off acid which affects the brain too.

Well I'm not going to bring it up unnecessarily if it doesn't look like we're living around where it could happen. For example, I want to move away from New York anyway. Out of (West Beth?) and all that. If we live somewhere where it's not apt to happen I'm not going to dwell on it or anything. But naturally I would expect them to be off of it in any permanent nature because I can't see any, of

course I can't predict the future for anybody but I can't see why they would need to take acid all their lives. Every day or anything like that. Acid is the kind of thing that if you, if you can take it without being, if you know yourself well enough, you can take acid.

If you don't know yourself too well, it's surprising the number of people who really don't know themselves really well, then it's not a good idea to take something like that because all of a sudden it's revealed to you. The villain in you for example, is revealed to you all of a sudden.

The villain being what been injected to you by the culture, by the outside institutions. And that's the basis of our schizophrenia that had been injected into us by the outside world to keep what's inside of us from coming out.
